0232Literature and linguistics

Swedish Proofreading

RenaissanceLabsEU/practice · swedish-proofreading

Correct Swedish compounds, agreement, pronouns and word order while preserving facts and already-correct text.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • Preserving roles, quantities, deadlines and negation
  • Recognising valid alternative phrasings
  • Following a concrete editorial brief

Reward

How it is scored
Mixed
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

Each document is checked against an explicit editorial contract. Accepted alternatives earn equal credit; changed facts, extra claims and edits outside the contract score zero for that document. The task reward is the mean document score.

How to run it

1. Get the tasksthis environment is one subset of the Practice dataset

hf download RenaissanceLabsEU/practice --repo-type dataset --include "tasks/swedish-proofreading/*" --local-dir Practice
cd Practice

Leave out --include to fetch every environment and the generators.

2. Check one task by handbuild it, run the reference solution, run the verifier

docker build -t practice-task tasks/swedish-proofreading/swedish-proofreading-agreement-d1-t0000/environment
docker run --rm --network none -v $PWD/tasks/swedish-proofreading/swedish-proofreading-agreement-d1-t0000/tests:/tests:ro -v $PWD/tasks/swedish-proofreading/swedish-proofreading-agreement-d1-t0000/solution:/solution:ro practice-task \
  bash -c 'bash /solution/solve.sh; bash /tests/test.sh; cat /logs/verifier/reward.txt'

Prints 1.0. Leave out bash /solution/solve.sh; to see the reward for doing nothing, which is 0.

3. Run it with an agenteach task folder is a Harbor task

harbor run --path tasks/swedish-proofreading --agent oracle
# then your own agent and model, for example:
# harbor run --path tasks/swedish-proofreading --agent terminus-2 --model <your-model>

The agent works in /app and writes /app/answer.json. The verifier writes the reward to /logs/verifier/reward.txt. Tasks tagged eval use seeds the train tasks never see.

4. Make more tasksthe generators are seeded and unlimited; needs the full download

python3 tools/export.py swedish_proofreading

Needs Docker. The Harbor commands follow the framework's usual pattern and were not run by us; the Docker check above was.

Evidence

All 324 Swedish task exports: standalone oracle 1.0, no-op 0. Adversarial and alternative-answer checks cover every published task; one hard task per family also passes in offline Docker.

Checked by our own test suite. No model has been trained on these tasks yet, so there is no evidence of training lift.
